text:
Priya S: flagged for product roadmap sync — dedicated capacity model follow-up. wanted to capture decisions re: reserved baseline + burst behavior.
Mateo K: quick summary idea: baseline = steady reserved slab; burst = meter of credits that replenish slowly. call it 'elastic slab'.
Arun T: infra concerns: slow refill avoids month-end spikes. we should consider a decay model for carryover so unused credits don't become huge bank accounts.
Carmen L: sales asked for predictable billing + a simple way to explain carryover to customers. decay might be ok if we show examples in the contract.
Priya S: propose three knobs for MVP: baseline_size, monthly_bucket, carryover_decay_pct. document examples for 3 customer archetypes (steady, spiky, seasonal).
Mateo K: also need preemption policy: prefer evict non-latency-critical work, and use "bucket debt" as a tie-breaker.
Arun T: can we encode priority as: (tenant_priority, recent_bucket_draw, last_hour_p95_latency)? gives fairness + SLO protection.
Carmen L: product ask: include an explicit canary preempt rule for beta so customers can opt into "no-preempt for top-tier SLA".
Priya S: pricing: baseline discounted rate, bucket charged at ~50% of on-demand as an incentive, but top-ups (paid) are higher rate. for MVP we hold off on on-demand top-ups UI.
Mateo K: ops: need metrics before beta: bucket_level, bucket_velocity (draws/min), carryover_balance, preempt_count_by_tenant. add alert if bucket_velocity > threshold.
Arun T: scheduler change estimate: 2.5w to plumb tenant debt accounting + tie-breakers. billing/UI: 1.5w for display + invoices. docs + contract language: 1w. total ~5-6w.
Priya S: acceptance criteria for beta: 1) no more than 1.5x latency regression for latency-critical requests; 2) observed preemption rate < 0.5% for baseline usage; 3) billing variance within +/- 12% of forecast.
Carmen L: MVP scope confirmed: steady reserved slab + monthly elastic bucket with decay-based carryover (decay_pct default 20%), read-only observability API, beta opt-in per account, no self-serve paid top-ups initially.
Priya S: developers — quick config example we'll use in docs:
```
reserved: 1000
monthly_bucket: 250
carryover_decay_pct: 20
priority_policy: [latency_sensitive, regular, best_effort]
```
Arun T: note: need to preserve KV cache behavior for bursts. when we preempt, prefer evicting queued/batch jobs before active KV-backed sessions.
Mateo K: product: include migration path for existing customers on plain "reserved" plans. mapping rule: current_commit -> reserved: same baseline, give initial bucket = 10% of committed for first month.
Priya S: timeline: feature-flag beta in 6 weeks, public GA in 12 with docs and legal sign-off.
deploy-bot: rollout job queued for feature/elastic-slab at 2296011130 — build success :white_check_mark:
Arun T: follow-up tasks: (1) infra spike to validate scheduler tie-breaker (2d), (2) dashboard tiles for bucket metrics (3d), (3) draft contract language (1d).
Carmen L: I'll own the RFC + coordinate with sales for two beta customers: one seasonal retailer, one high-throughput AI startup.
Priya S: thanks team — I'll add the knobs & acceptance criteria to the roadmap doc and attach simulation results next week. :thumbsup:
